verses.en: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.pt: O Poderoso, o Senhor Deus, fala e convoca a terra desde o nascer do sol até o seu ocaso.
verses.en_web: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of Asaph.> The God of gods, even the Lord, has sent out his voice, and the earth is full of fear; from the coming up of the sun to its going down.

verses.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
verses.pt: Desde Sião, a perfeição da formosura. Deus resplandece.
verses.en_web: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
verses.en_bbe: From Zion, most beautiful of places, God has sent out his light.

verses.en: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.pt: O nosso Deus vem, e não guarda silêncio; diante dele há um fogo devorador, e grande tormenta ao seu redor.
verses.en_web: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
verses.en_bbe: Our God will come, and will not keep quiet; with fire burning before him, and storm-winds round him.

verses.en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.pt: Ele intima os altos céus e a terra, para o julgamento do seu povo:
verses.en_web: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.en_bbe: His voice will go out to the heavens and to the earth, for the judging of his people:

verses.en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.pt: Congregai os meus santos, aqueles que fizeram comigo um pacto por meio de sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
verses.en_bbe: Let my saints come together to me; those who have made an agreement with me by offerings.

verses.en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
verses.pt: Os céus proclamam a justiça dele, pois Deus mesmo é Juiz.
verses.en_web: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: And let the heavens make clear his righteousness; for God himself is the judge. (Selah.)

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
verses.pt: Ouve, povo meu, e eu falarei; ouve, ó Israel, e eu te protestarei: Eu sou Deus, o teu Deus.
verses.en_web: “Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, O my people, to my words; O Israel, I will be a witness against you; I am God, even your God.

verses.en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.pt: Não te repreendo pelos teus sacrifícios, pois os teus holocaustos estão de contínuo perante mim.
verses.en_web: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.en_bbe: I will not take up a cause against you because of your offerings, or because of your burned offerings, which are ever before me.

verses.en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
verses.pt: Da tua casa não aceitarei novilho, nem bodes dos teus currais.
verses.en_web: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
verses.en_bbe: I will take no ox out of your house, or he-goats from your flocks;

verses.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.pt: Porque meu é todo animal da selva, e o gado sobre milhares de outeiros.
verses.en_web: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
verses.en_bbe: For every beast of the woodland is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

verses.en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.pt: Conheço todas as aves dos montes, e tudo o que se move no campo é meu.
verses.en_web: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
verses.en_bbe: I see all the birds of the mountains, and the beasts of the field are mine.

verses.en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.pt: Se eu tivesse fome, não to diria pois meu é o mundo e a sua plenitude.
verses.en_web: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
verses.en_bbe: If I had need of food, I would not give you word of it; for the earth is mine and all its wealth.

verses.en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.pt: Comerei eu carne de touros? ou beberei sangue de bodes?
verses.en_web: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.en_bbe: Am I to take the flesh of the ox for my food, or the blood of goats for my drink?

verses.en: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
verses.pt: Oferece a Deus por sacrifício ações de graças, e paga ao Altíssimo os teus votos;
verses.en_web: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.en_bbe: Make an offering of praise to God; keep the agreements which you have made with the Most High;

verses.en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
verses.pt: e invoca-me no dia da angústia; eu te livrarei, e tu me glorificarás.
verses.en_web: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
verses.en_bbe: Let your voice come up to me in the day of trouble; I will be your saviour, so that you may give glory to me.

verses.en: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
verses.pt: Mas ao ímpio diz Deus: Que fazes tu em recitares os meus estatutos, e em tomares o meu pacto na tua boca,
verses.en_web: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,
verses.en_bbe: But to the sinner, God says, What are you doing, talking of my laws, or taking the words of my agreement in your mouth?

verses.en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
verses.pt: visto que aborreces a correção, e lanças as minhas palavras para trás de ti?
verses.en_web: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that you have no desire for my teaching, turning your back on my words.

verses.en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
verses.pt: Quando vês um ladrão, tu te comprazes nele; e tens parte com os adúlteros.
verses.en_web: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
verses.en_bbe: When you saw a thief, you were in agreement with him, and you were joined with those who took other men's wives.

verses.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
verses.pt: Soltas a tua boca para o mal, e a tua língua trama enganos.
verses.en_web: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
verses.en_bbe: You have given your mouth to evil, your tongue to words of deceit.

verses.en: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.
verses.pt: Tu te sentas a falar contra teu irmão; difamas o filho de tua mãe.
verses.en_web: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.en_bbe: You say evil of your brother; you make false statements against your mother's son.

verses.en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
verses.pt: Estas coisas tens feito, e eu me calei; pensavas que na verdade eu era como tu; mas eu te argüirei, e tudo te porei à vista.
verses.en_web: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.
verses.en_bbe: These things have you done, and I said nothing; it seemed to you that I was such a one as yourself; but I will make a protest against you, and put them in order before your eyes.

verses.en: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.pt: Considerai pois isto, vós que vos esqueceis de Deus, para que eu não vos despedace, sem que haja quem vos livre.
verses.en_web: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
verses.en_bbe: Now keep this in mind, you who have no memory of God, for fear that you may be crushed under my hand, with no one to give you help:

verses.en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
verses.pt: Aquele que oferece por sacrifício ações de graças me glorifica; e àquele que bem ordena o seu caminho eu mostrarei a salvação de Deus.
verses.en_web: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”
verses.en_bbe: Whoever makes an offering of praise gives glory to me; and to him who is upright in his ways I will make clear the salvation of God.
